Fleet Command Sounds

30 sounds for the battle: every weapon mount firing, what the shots hit, the ship itself, the console keys and the alerts, and the bridge under it all. 18 are cut from real recordings (CC0 packs from OpenGameArt: digital lasers and phasers, electric charges and shield hits, real explosions, rocket motors, a ship's cannon, a computer room), slowed and layered to starship size; the console tones and alerts are synthesised. Battle sounds are mono and placed in 3D at their ship or mount; the console, the alerts and the bridge bed are not. Cues marked rec are recorded.

Cues 30Recorded 18Synthesised 12Format mono 44.1 kHz OGGLicence CC0 and ours

Each recorded cue names its originals in assets/audio/sfx/SOURCES.md. Not in the game yet: playing them is the sound plan (openspec/changes/sound-effects), after the owner's approval.

Cuts: tools/audio/cut_cc0.py to tools/audio/cc0_cues.json · Synthesis: tools/audio/gen_sfx.py · Encode: tools/audio/render_sfx.sh · Game copies: assets/audio/sfx/*.ogg · Plan: openspec/changes/sound-effects Every pack and its licence: AUDIO_SOURCES.md · Method: the sound-effects skill
